summary: The reported scalar-only adapter failure reproduces at d257b58e67193780ff8a59ab54b48219b9dc28d2, but the prepared base already contains the functional fix from upstream PR #30827. Added regression coverage for per-prompt lists, scalar broadcasting, and independent wrong-length validation of extra_key and cache_salt; no runtime source change was needed.

tests.what_was_measured: Imported the historical checkout explicitly and observed the reported TypeError for schema-valid list values of both extra_key and cache_salt. The script catches and prints each expected failure so both fields are measured in one run. Raw output: reports/j-e716fe2b73c7/evidence/historical_reproduction.log

Three focused regressions passed: elementwise per-prompt mapping for both fields, scalar broadcasting for both fields, and mismatched-list rejection independently for each field. Raw output: reports/j-e716fe2b73c7/evidence/focused_regression.log

All 22 completion-serving unit tests passed, including the new regressions and existing distinct-field and single-request boundaries. Raw output: reports/j-e716fe2b73c7/evidence/full_serving_completions_unit.log

gpu_execution.evidence: The failure and correction are confined to CPU-side Pydantic request adaptation and GenerateReqInput normalization before tokenization or engine execution; GPU execution would not measure the reported defect.

remaining_limitations: No live HTTP server or model inference was run because the source-level failure occurs before those stages.
The tests qualify completion request adaptation and normalization only; they do not qualify model semantic accuracy, another model architecture, or a distributed workload.
